preconditions.description: Attacker must be contract owner to set operationsAddress via setOperationsAddress()
Contract must have accumulated tokensForOperations > 0 to trigger swapBack() execution
Contract balance must be >= swapTokensAtAmount to enable swapBack

logic_check.expected_value: 0 after swapBack should empty contract ETH balance

exploit_hint: 1. As owner, call setOperationsAddress() with a contract that rejects ETH transfers (no receive/fallback payable function). 2. Trigger token transfers that accumulate fees until tokensForOperations > 0 and contract token balance >= swapTokensAtAmount. 3. This triggers swapBack() which attempts to send ETH to operationsAddress via unchecked .call{value: ...}. 4. The transfer fails silently (success=false not checked), ETH remains stuck in contract, but tokensForOperations is reset to 0. 5. Contract state becomes inconsistent - fees collected but never distributed.
